explanation: Q2 = -0.5 GeV² is physically impossible in EXCLURAD. The code is designed for spacelike Q² > 0 (valid eta range: 0.3–5.0 GeV²). Negative Q² causes mathematical errors: log(Q2/aml2) takes log of negative number, and 1/q2 divisions produce undefined results. The kinematic formulas and radiative correction parameters all assume Q² > 0.
